translation.name: Biblica® Se aɖeke mebla Biblia zazã o Agbenya La™

content.text: “Minɔ ʋɔnu dzɔdzɔe dɔdrɔ̃ dzi,
eye miwɔ nu si le dzɔdzɔe,
elabena nye ɖeɖe tsɔ ɖe mia gbɔ,
eye esusɔ vie woaɖe
nye dzɔdzɔenyenye ɖe go.
Woayra ame si wɔna alea heléa eme ɖe asi sesĩe,
ame si megblẽa kɔ ɖo na Dzudzɔgbe la o,
ke boŋ wòléa eme ɖe asi,
eye menana eƒe asi wɔa nu vɔ̃ɖi o.”
Amedzro si tsɔ eɖokui na Yehowa la megagblɔ be,
“Yehowa le ɖe nye ge ɖa le eƒe dukɔ la dome” o.
Ŋutsu si wota hã megafa konyi agblɔ be,
“Ati ƒuƒu ko menye” o.

content: Elabena ale Yehowa gblɔe nye esi,

content.text: “Ne ŋutsu siwo wota, lé nye Dzudzɔgbe me ɖe asi,
hetia nu si dzea ŋunye,
eye wolé nye nubabla me ɖe asi goŋgoŋ la,
mana ŋkuɖodzikpe kple ŋkɔ wo ɖe
nye gbedoxɔ kple eƒe gliwo me,
esi nyo wu viŋutsuwo kple vinyɔnuwo.
Matsɔ ŋkɔ mavɔ si womate ŋu
aɖe ɖa akpɔ gbeɖe o la na wo.
Ke hena amedzro siwo ku ɖe Yehowa ŋu
be woanye dɔlawo nɛ,
woalɔ̃ Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ, eye woasubɔe.
Wo ame siwo katã lé nye Dzudzɔgbe me ɖe asi,
womegblẽ kɔ ɖo nɛ o,
eye woku ɖe nye nubabla ŋu vevie la,
woawoe makplɔ ava nye to kɔkɔe la dzi,
eye mado dzidzɔ na wo le nye gbedoxɔ me.
Maxɔ woƒe numevɔsa kple akpedavɔsa
siwo wotsɔ va nye vɔsamlekpui dzi,
elabena woayɔ nye aƒe
la be dukɔwo katã ƒe gbedoxɔ.”
Aƒetɔ Yehowa, ame si ƒo Israel ƒe amewo nu ƒu la be,
“Magaƒo ame bubuwo nu ƒu,
akpe ɖe ame siwo ƒo ƒu xoxo la ŋu.”

content: Mawu tsɔ nya ɖe ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ŋu

content.text: Miva, mi lã wɔadãwo katã.
Miva ne miavuvu nu,
mi avemelã wɔadãwo katã!
Israel ƒe gbetakpɔlawo katã nye ŋkugbagbãtɔwo.
Nunya metso aƒe ɖe wo gbɔ o.
Avu si ƒe aɖe tu lae wonye.
Womate ŋu awo o.
Womlɔa anyi hekua drɔ̃e,
eye alɔ̃ vivia wo nu.
Wonye avu siwo ɖua nutsu;
nu meɖia ƒo na wo o.
Wonye alẽkplɔla siwo mesea nugɔme o.
Wo katã wolé woƒe mɔ tsɔ,
ɖe sia ɖe le eya ŋutɔ ƒe viɖe dim.
Ɖe sia ɖe doa ɣli be,
“Miva, mina ne maku wain vɛ!
Miva ne miano aha muame wòasu mi!
Etsɔ hã nanɔ abe egbe ene
alo nanyo sãa wu gɔ̃ hã.”
